‘Circular investment’ is a stupid made up term for people who don’t understand business and financing. 

Companies have been investing in their supply chain since before th stock market existed. 

Sony invested in DRAM. Commercial laundry machine company Jenson invested in commercial laundry chemical company Ecolab. Everyone’s does it as a win win. Easier access to capital for growth, create stronger partnership with your long term suppliers, make your supply more secure, create a little downward pressure on pricing within your supply chain, ensure your supply chain can survive cyclical and growth pressures. 

All this BS about “circular financing” is pure shock jock idiocy the press/media loves to use tactically to keep eyeballs on their fear train.
